Bug_Title: SQL: Method attempts to access a result set field with index 0 (SQL_BAD_RESULTSET_ACCESS)
Bug_Details:
A call to getXXX or updateXXX methods of a result set was made where the
field index is 0. As ResultSet fields start at index 1, this is always a mistake.
Bug_Explanation: The code attempts to access a result set field using index 0, which is incorrect because ResultSet fields are 1-based. This will cause an SQLException during runtime.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method, which attempts to access a ResultSet field with index 0. This triggers an SQLException because ResultSet fields are 1-based.
